topic.title: Heat Networks / Zoning / Authorisation
topic.source_contract: heat-demand baseline, zone opportunity, zoning pipeline, designation, network operator and supplier, project development, funding, planning and highways permissions, authorisation, registration, consumer protection, construction, commissioning, connections, supply and performance monitoring evidence

scope_guards: A zone opportunity area is not a designated heat network zone.
A pipeline listing is not a construction commitment.
Feasibility funding is not a capital delivery award.
Authorisation is not a completed network.
Commissioning is not evidence of sustained heat supply.
A planned connection is not an active customer connection.
No score or promotion is written without exact designation, permissions, construction, supply and monitoring evidence.
